# Register scheduled task with proper quoting (path has spaces)
$taskName = "RootMC-AvaIvy-Autostart"
$script = 'D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Web Files\rootmc-ava\scripts\start-ava-on-boot.ps1'
$arg = "-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"$script`""
$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute "powershell.exe" -Argument $arg
$trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn
$settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries -StartWhenAvailable
$principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId $env:USERNAME -LogonType Interactive -RunLevel Limited
try {
  Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName -Action $action -Trigger $trigger -Settings $settings -Principal $principal -Force | Out-Null
  Write-Host "Registered: $taskName"
  Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName | Format-List TaskName, State, TaskPath
} catch {
  Write-Host "Register failed: $($_.Exception.Message)"
  # Try elevating via Start-Process RunAs
  $elev = @"
`$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
`$taskName='$taskName'
`$script='$script'
`$arg='-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"$script`"'
`$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' -Argument `$arg
`$trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn
`$settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries -StartWhenAvailable
`$principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId '$env:USERNAME' -LogonType Interactive -RunLevel Limited
Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName `$taskName -Confirm:`$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName `$taskName -Action `$action -Trigger `$trigger -Settings `$settings -Principal `$principal -Force | Out-Null
Write-Host 'Elevated register OK'
"@
  $tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP "reg-ava-task.ps1"
  Set-Content -Path $tmp -Value $elev -Encoding UTF8
  Start-Process powershell.exe -Verb RunAs -ArgumentList "-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"$tmp`"" -Wait
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
  Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-List TaskName, State
}
input.description: Register Ava autostart scheduled task
